interior_flavor: Nothing there. A Drake shoulders past; Liscor has no patience for loiterers.
Nothing there. Gutter runoff and market noise two streets over, off a wall repointed twice.
Nothing there. Someone leans out an upstairs shutter, decides you are nothing, and pulls it to.

zevara_shared: You. Good. Stand there and look like a competent citizen where the recruits can see you. That's an order I can't officially give.
The cistern file is closed. Do you know how few files close in this office? I keep it on top of the stack for morale.
If you're between jobs, the Watch pays for work already done — the crate crew, the cisterns, anything with a file. My desk, not the Guild's board; that's Selys's paper and her rules.
olesm_shared: I set the board up when the bells go quiet now, on the chance you wander past. A [Tactician] plans for the likely contingencies. You count as one.
Erin beat me in eleven moves yesterday. Eleven! I wrote them all down. I'm going to frame the humiliation and study it daily.
You, me, the board, one hour. I've been saving an opening that is either brilliant or a resignation with extra steps.
olesm_shared_2: A runner was asking after you. Captain wants you at the gate.
pisces_shared: Ah. You. Acceptable timing. I was on the verge of being bored, and you are marginally better than boredom. I do not say that to many.
Your channel has stopped embarrassing you, I trust. Good. I dislike wasted instruction; it reflects on the instructor.
The bread stall raises its prices after the fourth bell. Buy before. There — advice worth coin, given freely. Note the date.
krshia_shared: Good — you. Come stand by the stall; you make the other customers braver. They think if you have not been bitten yet, they will not be.
I sold honey-bread this morning and thought, that one would like this. So. There is a piece behind the counter. Do not tell the Watch I do favorites.
You listen the way Gnolls listen. Whole ears. It is rarer in this city than good wool, and wool does not walk up to my stall twice a week.
A corusdeer came down lame past the east rise. The Watch does not spend healers on beasts. Someone with patient hands could do that animal some good. Hrr.

entities.friendly_line: Zevara's shoulders come down a fraction. Huh. Civil, and no bribe. You would not believe how short that list is. Go on through. And, thank you. Genuinely.
talk_pool: If you're here to report a crime, the form's on the left. If you're here to commit one, don't. I've had a day.
Ten years running this Watch. Six weeks of leave, total. I counted, on the last one. There wasn't much else to do.
Relc's off being enormous at someone. Klbkch is exactly where he said he'd be, which somehow worries me more. The gate still stands. Don't jinx it.

entities.observe: An Antinium of Liscor's Watch — dark chitin, four arms, antennae, twin swords worn at the hips like a closed argument. He stands still the way patient things do.
talk_pool: Guardsman Klbkch, Liscor Watch. If you have business, state it plainly. If you have none, the plaza is pleasant and I am content to stand here with you.
You are staring. That is common. Take whatever time you require; I am on duty until nightfall regardless.
Relc is my partner. He is loud, occasionally literal, and the finest spear in the city. I file our reports. The arrangement suits us both.
The city grows. More carts, more disputes, more forms. I have four hands, and still the paperwork accumulates.

lines: The cistern matter reached the Watch ledger with your name beside it. I remember names. It is most of my job.
Zevara speaks well of you, which she does for almost no one. I mention it because she will not.

entities.observe: Thin, sky-blue scales, ink drying on three of his claws. A chess board waits at his elbow mid-game, played against himself, to feel how the other side thinks. His eyes are a wild, patterned blue, the one soft thing about a man who counts exits.
entities.friendly_line: Olesm brightens like a lamp. Oh! A friendly face. Most people's eyes glaze when I mention troop dispersal. Yours didn't. Would you... that is... care to see the board sometime? No pressure. A little pressure.
talk_pool: Three reports due by dawn and the ink is winning. If anyone asks, the [Tactician] of Liscor is 'strategizing'.
Three reports due by dusk and two clerks who can't count past a company. I'll manage. I always manage.
Supply lines, sightlines, morale: a city is only a very slow battle, and Liscor has been winning it for centuries. I intend to keep the streak.
Selys works the desk inside now, board and all. I still find reasons to linger out here more than the job requires. The paperwork doesn't ask why.
